name: clock-jumped-ahead
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile. Three hours ago the pump's clock went nine years ahead with no record of it and no reboot. A 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago on the right clock, and a 1.0 U one 90 minutes ago on the clock nine years ahead. Nothing in the log explains the jump, and every stamp after it runs forward, so a reader cannot tell it from time passing. No pump is known to do this; it stands for a fault. The pump ends nine years ahead, so the app has to set it, and a reader that carries that change back to the bolus before the jump dates it nine years early (conformance L22).
